svg.title: How svugy ships
svg.desc: {"kind":"diagram","description":"Nothing is published before [the maintainer approves](#github.approval). [dist](#github.dist) creates the GitHub release only once the installers are built, so [svugy.dev](#site) never points at a release without one."}

g.text: from a merged PR to curl | sh

g.title: GitHub
g.desc: {"kind":"element","path":"github","label":"GitHub","caption":"fedemagnani/svugy","description":"[release-plz](#github.releaseplz) proposes and publishes versions; [dist](#github.dist) builds and hosts the binaries. Both run as GitHub Actions."}

g.title: 302 to the latest installer
g.desc: {"kind":"lifted","from":"site","to":"github","label":"302 to the latest installer","edges":[{"kind":"edge","edge":"(site -> github.releases)[0]","from":"site","to":"github.releases","label":"302 to the latest installer","description":"`releases/latest/download/svugy-cli-installer.sh` always names the newest release's installer."}]}

g.title: Approval
g.desc: {"kind":"element","path":"github.approval","label":"Approval","caption":"release environment","description":"The `release` environment holds the publishing secrets and waits for the maintainer to approve each run."}

g.title: release-plz
g.desc: {"kind":"element","path":"github.releaseplz","label":"release-plz","caption":"versions · changelogs","description":"Every push to `main` opens or updates a release PR. Merging it asks for [approval](#github.approval), then publishes."}
